'''Luisa Torsi''' (born 1964) is an [[Italians|Italian]] [[chemist]] who is a professor at the [[Università degli Studi di Bari]]. She was the first woman to serve as President of the [[European Materials Research Society]] (E-MRS). In 2019 she was named by the [[International Union of Pure and Applied Chemistry]] as one of the world's most Distinguished Women in Chemistry.<ref>{{Cite web|date=2019-02-07|title=Awardees of the IUPAC 2019 Distinguished Women in Chemistry or Chemical Engineering|url=https://iupac.org/iupac-2019-distinguished-women/|access-date=2020-08-02|website=IUPAC {{!}} International Union of Pure and Applied Chemistry|language=en-US}}</ref>

== Early life and education ==
Torsi was born in [[Bari]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|title=Luisa Torsi|url=https://ricerca.repubblica.it/repubblica/archivio/repubblica/2018/09/15/luisa-torsi-il-micro-transistor-made-in-bari-scopre-le-malattieBari09.html|access-date=2020-08-02|website=Archivio - la Repubblica.it|language=it}}</ref> She earned her undergraduate degree in physics at the [[University of Bari]]. Torsi has said that she realised that she wanted to be a researcher during her master's research project.<ref name=":1">{{Cite journal|last=Oberbeckmann-Winter|first=Nicola|date=2020-08-01|title=Robert Kellner Lecture awarded to ABC author Luisa Torsi|journal=Analytical and Bioanalytical Chemistry|language=en|volume=412|issue=21|pages=4997–4999|doi=10.1007/s00216-019-02373-1|issn=1618-2650|doi-access=free}}</ref> She remained there for her graduate studies, switching specialties to chemical sciences. In 1994 Torsi moved to the [[United States]], where she joined [[Bell Labs]] as a postdoctoral researcher. During her postdoctoral research Torsi investigated [[Organic field-effect transistor|organic field-effect transistors]] .<ref name=":1" />

In 2015 Torsi delivered a [[TED (conference)|TED talk]] at TEDxBari, where she discussed resilience.<ref>{{Cite web|title=TEDxBari {{!}} TED|url=https://www.ted.com/tedx/events/16150|access-date=2020-08-02|website=www.ted.com}}</ref> Torsi serves on the editorial board of [[ACS Omega]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=ACS Omega|url=https://pubs.acs.org/page/acsodf/editorial-board.html|access-date=2020-08-02|website=pubs.acs.org|language=en}}</ref>
